logline: While Alexander reassures Juliana of their unbreakable bond amid the council's opposition, a destitute Catherine begs for sanctuary at Ashbourne—only for Juliana to offer her survival under the strict humiliation of a scullery maid.
continuity_notes: Follows Episode 46's ecclesiastical challenge by the High Priest. While Catherine plots in secret to remain on the estate, the morning brings her disgrace to light as Juliana decides her fate.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Stern, Demanding)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: You will scrub the manor hearths at dawn.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Unforgiving)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: You will scour the kitchen grease until midnight.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Stern, Final)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: One complaint from the housekeeper, and you are cast out with nothing.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Choked, Humiliated)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: You humiliate me.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Calm, Sovereign)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I offer you bread and honest labor. Take the apron, or leave the county.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Broken, Defeated)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: I accept, Your Grace.
